pairs.why: A's hat has a softer, more matte felt finish, while B's hat has stronger plastic shine on the brim and crown, the 'statue' gloss the lessons marked down.
Both hats are equally smooth and slightly plastic, with only small differences in where the highlights fall, so neither is clearly closer.
A has the gentler matte felt shading, and B has a glossier, higher-contrast finish that reads more like molded plastic.
A's crown is shiny and B's brim is shiny, so they are about equally glossy and both lack the soft material texture of the real cards.
The two hats are nearly identical in shape, color and plastic sheen, so neither has a meaningful edge.
A's lighting is softer and less specular, which fits the felt material better than B's glossy toy-like surface.
Both hats have similar shiny crown highlights and very smooth surfaces, and neither is distinguishably closer.
